source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.5, printed pages 80-81, with Sample Problem 4.10 worked and Quick Check 4.4 answered.

blocks.text: Solution ki molar concentration mol/dm³ mein likhi jati hai. Yeh batati hai ke 1 dm³ solution mein kisi substance (reactant ya product) ke kitne moles ghule (dissolved) hue hain. Moles aur molar concentration ka taalluq yeh hai:
Yahan C molar concentration hai aur V solution ka volume (dm³ mein).

blocks.alt: Concept map: beech mein peela daira 'Number of moles', aur us se chaar khamdar neele teer chaar neele bezavi khaanon (ovals) ki taraf jate hain jin ke kinare gulabi hain: 'Mass / Molar mass' (oopar baen), 'Volume / Molar Volume' (oopar daen), 'No. of particles / Avogadro's no.' (neeche baen) aur 'Conc. x Volume' (neeche daen).
blocks.caption: Moles ki tadaad ka concept map (kitab ke safha 80 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Moles chaar raston se nikalte hain: solid ka mass ÷ molar mass; STP par gas ka volume ÷ molar volume (22.4 dm³); particles ki tadaad ÷ Avogadro’s number; aur solution ki molar concentration x volume (dm³ mein). Sawal mein jo cheez di gayi ho, wahi rasta chunein.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 4.10
blocks.problem: 1 dm³ solution mein 27.64 g K₂CO₃ ghula hua hai. Molar concentration nikalein.
steps: K₂CO₃ ka molar mass = 138.2 g mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt: 1 dm³ solution mein 7.9 g KMnO₄ ghula hai (molar mass 158 g mol⁻¹). Molar concentration nikalein. (Mazeed: 250 cm³ mein 4.0 g NaOH, 40 g/mol, ki concentration?)
blocks.explanation: KMnO₄: n = 7.9 ÷ 158 = 0.05 mol, to C = 0.05 mol dm⁻³. NaOH: n = 4.0 ÷ 40 = 0.1 mol aur V = 250 cm³ = 0.250 dm³, to C = 0.1 ÷ 0.250 = 0.40 mol dm⁻³.

items: Molar concentration C = n ÷ V (mol dm⁻³); n = C x V.
1 dm³ mein 27.64 g K₂CO₃ (138.2 g/mol) = 0.2 mol dm⁻³.
